lead.title: Nouscom raises €120M Series D for its preventive vaccine against Lynch syndrome cancers
lead.deck: The oversubscribed round is co-led by M Ventures and Revelation Partners, with new entrants (Angelini Industries, the European Investment Bank via Aurea, Neva SGR). It funds a single registration-enabling trial for NOUS-209, an off-the-shelf vaccine encoding 209 shared neoantigens, whose design was discussed with the FDA and EMA.

milestone.title: Ascendis wins positive CHMP opinion for navepegritide (Yuviwel) in pediatric achondroplasia
milestone.summary: The EMA committee recommends approval of this once-weekly treatment for children aged 2 and older. In the 52-week study, treated children grew 1.49 cm more per year than on placebo.
milestone.why: A weekly injection versus BioMarin's daily Voxzogo: the adherence advantage is the heart of the thesis. The European Commission's final decision is still to come.

deal.thesis: Merck KGaA is buying the UK RNAi biotech for cash at $20 per ADS, a 130% premium to the October 16 close, after a competitive process. The price rewards Phase 2 data seen as potentially best-in-class for divesiran in polycythemia vera; closing expected in Q1 2027.

brefsEurope.title: OSE: Tedopi with docetaxel or nivolumab lifts one-year survival to 47% and 46% (vs 29%) in lung cancer
brefsEurope.summary: Phase 2 Combi-TED, 106 HLA-A2+ patients who failed chemotherapy and immunotherapy. No Tedopi-alone arm, so the contribution of the combinations remains to be isolated; full results at ESMO on October 25.

brefsEurope.title: Orphelia Pharma wins positive CHMP opinion for Kizfizo (liquid temozolomide) in glioblastoma
brefsEurope.summary: Indicated for adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma and for adults and children with recurrent malignant glioma. CHMP had rejected the product in 2025 in pediatric neuroblastoma: a second chance.

brefsEurope.title: Evaxion: EVX-01 vaccine responses in melanoma hold at three years
brefsEurope.summary: In the Phase 2, all patients kept their clinical response at three years, with no tumor progression. A 16-patient study, results reported by the company.

brefsEurope.title: BioInvent publishes first-in-human data for BI-1808, an anti-TNFR2 antibody
brefsEurope.summary: Phase 1 dose escalation reached no maximum tolerated dose; all treatment-related adverse events are grade 1 or 2.

brefsEurope.title: Calluna completes dosing in its Phase 2 AURORA trial in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
brefsEurope.summary: Dosing of CAL101 in the AURORA study is finished; topline results are expected in Q1 2027.

brefsIntl.title: Roche signs a new ADC pact with Hansoh, up to $15B in biobucks
brefsIntl.summary: A year after their first collaboration, the Swiss group returns to the Chinese ADC specialist: one more comparable of the weight of Chinese licenses in European pharma portfolios.

brefsIntl.title: CHMP backs Rasonque (daraxonrasib) in previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer
brefsIntl.summary: 500-patient Phase 3: median overall survival of 12.4 months versus 6.7 months on chemotherapy. Reviewed through the EMA's Cancer Medicines Pathfinder.

word.definition: A vaccine that teaches the immune system to recognize protein fragments unique to the tumor (neoantigens), absent from healthy cells.

parts.label: Neoantigens
parts.role: the target, specific to the tumor

parts.label: Vector
parts.role: the viral vehicle that delivers them

parts.label: T cells
parts.role: the soldiers that attack the marked cells

how.t: Either neoantigens shared between patients (NOUS-209: 209 frameshift neoantigens), or an algorithm-individualized selection (up to 30 for TG4050).
The targets are encoded in viral vectors (two vectors for NOUS-209, MVA virus for TG4050) or peptides (EVX-01).
The immune system produces CD8 T cells directed against these markers, to prevent or delay the tumor.

word.why: VC angle: Nouscom's €120M round shows that cancer prevention in carriers of a genetic syndrome (Lynch) is becoming fundable, with a registration trial design discussed with the FDA and EMA. Caution: the data come from small studies compared with historical data or reported by the companies.

startups.name: Nouscom
startups.use: Off-the-shelf vaccine NOUS-209 (209 shared neoantigens) for Lynch syndrome; €120M Series D, FDA Fast Track

startups.name: Evaxion
startups.use: AI-designed individualized vaccine EVX-01; Phase 2 in melanoma with 75% objective response (12 of 16 patients) at two years

startups.name: Transgene
startups.use: TG4050, individualized MVA-vector vaccine encoding up to 30 neoantigens, with NEC; Phase 1 data published in Nature Communications (September 2026)
